mapper.select: /* CastSmltMapper.retrieveWaitPsgList */ SELECT TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(A.SMLT_ACTL_DT, 'HH24')) AS HOUR, SUM(A.WTNG_PSG_CNT) AS WAIT_PSG_CNT FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_RSLT_DTL A INNER JOIN PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_PSG_FCLT B ON A.PSG_FCLT_CD = B.PSG_FCLT_CD WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.SMLT_ID = #{smltId} AND B.TMNL_ID = #{tmnlId} AND B.USE_YN = 'Y' AND A.WTNG_PSG_CNT > 0 AND B.UP_PSG_FCLT_CD IN (#{item}) GROUP BY TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(A.SMLT_ACTL_DT, 'HH24')) ORDER BY HOUR

/* CastSmltMapper.retrieveSmltKpiRaw */ SELECT ROUND(AVG(A.AVG_WTNG_HR)) AS AVG_WTNG_HR, ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY A.AVG_WTNG_HR)) AS P95_WTNG_HR, MAX(A.WTNG_PSG_CNT) AS MAX_WTNG_PSG_CNT FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_RSLT_DTL A INNER JOIN PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_PSG_FCLT B ON A.PSG_FCLT_CD = B.PSG_FCLT_CD WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.SMLT_ID = #{smltId} AND B.TMNL_ID = #{tmnlId} AND B.USE_YN = 'Y' AND A.WTNG_PSG_CNT > 0 AND B.UP_PSG_FCLT_CD IN (#{item})

/* CastSmltMapper.retrieveSmltFlfmt */ SELECT A.SMLT_ID, A.SMLT_TYPE, A.EXCN_YMD, A.TMNL_ID, A.SMLT_STTS, TO_CHAR(A.SMLT_BGNG_DT, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AS SMLT_FLFMT_BGNG_DT, TO_CHAR(A.SMLT_END_DT, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AS SMLT_FLFMT_END_DT, NVL(ROUND((CAST(A.SMLT_END_DT AS DATE) - CAST(A.SMLT_BGNG_DT AS DATE)) * 1440), 0) AS EXEC_MIN, A.FRST_RGTR_ID AS RGTR_ID, NVL(C.USER_NM, '') AS USER_NM, NVL(D.DEPT_NM, '') AS DEPT_NM FROM ( SELECT U.SMLT_ID, 'WhatIf' AS SMLT_TYPE, U.EXCN_YMD, CASE WHEN U.SMLT_STTS = 'Failed' THEN 'Failed' WHEN S.SMLT_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'Finished' WHEN U.SMLT_STTS = 'New' THEN 'New' ELSE 'Executing' END AS SMLT_STTS, U.QUEUE_DT AS SMLT_REQ_DT, NVL(S.SMLT_BGNG_DT, U.EXCT_DT) AS SMLT_BGNG_DT, CASE WHEN U.SMLT_STTS = 'Failed' THEN NVL(U.END_DT, S.SMLT_END_DT) ELSE S.SMLT_END_DT END AS SMLT_END_DT, U.FRST_RGTR_ID, U.FRST_REG_DT, NVL(S.TMNL_ID, 'P01') AS TMNL_ID FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_USER_MSTR U LEFT JOIN ( SELECT SMLT_ID, MIN(SMLT_TYPE) AS SMLT_TYPE, MIN(EXCN_YMD) AS EXCN_YMD, MIN(TMNL_ID) AS TMNL_ID, MIN(PLAN_BGNG_DT) AS SMLT_BGNG_DT, MAX(PLAN_END_DT) AS SMLT_END_DT, MIN(FRST_RGTR_ID) KEEP (DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY FRST_REG_DT) AS FRST_RGTR_ID, MIN(FRST_REG_DT) AS FRST_REG_DT FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_STNG GROUP BY SMLT_ID ) S ON S.SMLT_ID = U.SMLT_ID UNION ALL SELECT S.SMLT_ID, S.SMLT_TYPE, S.EXCN_YMD, 'Finished' AS SMLT_STTS, CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP(6)) AS SMLT_REQ_DT, S.SMLT_BGNG_DT, S.SMLT_END_DT, S.FRST_RGTR_ID, S.FRST_REG_DT, S.TMNL_ID FROM ( SELECT SMLT_ID, MIN(SMLT_TYPE) AS SMLT_TYPE, MIN(EXCN_YMD) AS EXCN_YMD, MIN(TMNL_ID) AS TMNL_ID, MIN(PLAN_BGNG_DT) AS SMLT_BGNG_DT, MAX(PLAN_END_DT) AS SMLT_END_DT, MIN(FRST_RGTR_ID) KEEP (DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY FRST_REG_DT) AS FRST_RGTR_ID, MIN(FRST_REG_DT) AS FRST_REG_DT FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_STNG GROUP BY SMLT_ID ) S WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_USER_MSTR U WHERE U.SMLT_ID = S.SMLT_ID) AND S.SMLT_TYPE = 'Auto' ) A LEFT JOIN CAOWN.TN_CA_USER C ON A.FRST_RGTR_ID = C.USER_ID LEFT JOIN CAOWN.TN_CA_DEPT D ON C.DEPT_CD = D.DEPT_CD WHERE A.SMLT_ID = #{smltId}

/* CastSmltMapper.retrieveSmltFlfmtList */ SELECT A.SMLT_ID, A.SMLT_TYPE, A.EXCN_YMD, A.TMNL_ID, A.SMLT_STTS, TO_CHAR(A.SMLT_BGNG_DT, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AS SMLT_FLFMT_BGNG_DT, TO_CHAR(A.SMLT_END_DT, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AS SMLT_FLFMT_END_DT, NVL(ROUND((CAST(A.SMLT_END_DT AS DATE) - CAST(A.SMLT_BGNG_DT AS DATE)) * 1440), 0) AS EXEC_MIN, A.FRST_RGTR_ID AS RGTR_ID, NVL(C.USER_NM, '') AS USER_NM, NVL(D.DEPT_NM, '') AS DEPT_NM FROM ( SELECT U.SMLT_ID, 'WhatIf' AS SMLT_TYPE, U.EXCN_YMD, CASE WHEN U.SMLT_STTS = 'Failed' THEN 'Failed' WHEN S.SMLT_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'Finished' WHEN U.SMLT_STTS = 'New' THEN 'New' ELSE 'Executing' END AS SMLT_STTS, U.QUEUE_DT AS SMLT_REQ_DT, NVL(S.SMLT_BGNG_DT, U.EXCT_DT) AS SMLT_BGNG_DT, CASE WHEN U.SMLT_STTS = 'Failed' THEN NVL(U.END_DT, S.SMLT_END_DT) ELSE S.SMLT_END_DT END AS SMLT_END_DT, U.FRST_RGTR_ID, U.FRST_REG_DT, NVL(S.TMNL_ID, 'P01') AS TMNL_ID FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_USER_MSTR U LEFT JOIN ( SELECT SMLT_ID, MIN(SMLT_TYPE) AS SMLT_TYPE, MIN(EXCN_YMD) AS EXCN_YMD, MIN(TMNL_ID) AS TMNL_ID, MIN(PLAN_BGNG_DT) AS SMLT_BGNG_DT, MAX(PLAN_END_DT) AS SMLT_END_DT, MIN(FRST_RGTR_ID) KEEP (DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY FRST_REG_DT) AS FRST_RGTR_ID, MIN(FRST_REG_DT) AS FRST_REG_DT FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_STNG GROUP BY SMLT_ID ) S ON S.SMLT_ID = U.SMLT_ID UNION ALL SELECT S.SMLT_ID, S.SMLT_TYPE, S.EXCN_YMD, 'Finished' AS SMLT_STTS, CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP(6)) AS SMLT_REQ_DT, S.SMLT_BGNG_DT, S.SMLT_END_DT, S.FRST_RGTR_ID, S.FRST_REG_DT, S.TMNL_ID FROM ( SELECT SMLT_ID, MIN(SMLT_TYPE) AS SMLT_TYPE, MIN(EXCN_YMD) AS EXCN_YMD, MIN(TMNL_ID) AS TMNL_ID, MIN(PLAN_BGNG_DT) AS SMLT_BGNG_DT, MAX(PLAN_END_DT) AS SMLT_END_DT, MIN(FRST_RGTR_ID) KEEP (DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY FRST_REG_DT) AS FRST_RGTR_ID, MIN(FRST_REG_DT) AS FRST_REG_DT FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_STNG GROUP BY SMLT_ID ) S WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_USER_MSTR U WHERE U.SMLT_ID = S.SMLT_ID) AND S.SMLT_TYPE = 'Auto' ) A LEFT JOIN CAOWN.TN_CA_USER C ON A.FRST_RGTR_ID = C.USER_ID LEFT JOIN CAOWN.TN_CA_DEPT D ON C.DEPT_CD = D.DEPT_CD WHERE TO_CHAR(NVL(A.SMLT_REQ_DT, A.SMLT_BGNG_DT), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MI') BETWEEN #{bgnDt} AND #{endDt} ORDER BY NVL(A.SMLT_REQ_DT, A.SMLT_BGNG_DT) DESC, TO_NUMBER(A.SMLT_ID) DESC

/* CastSmltMapper.retrieveSmltFlfmtSmry */ SELECT COUNT(*) TOT_CNT, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN SMLT_STTS = 'Finished' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) DONE_CNT, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN SMLT_STTS IN ('New', 'Executing') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) RUNNING_CNT, NVL(ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN SMLT_STTS = 'Finished' THEN (CAST(SMLT_END_DT AS DATE) - CAST(SMLT_BGNG_DT AS DATE)) * 86400 END)), 0) AVG_EXEC_SEC FROM ( SELECT U.SMLT_ID, 'WhatIf' AS SMLT_TYPE, U.EXCN_YMD, CASE WHEN U.SMLT_STTS = 'Failed' THEN 'Failed' WHEN S.SMLT_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'Finished' WHEN U.SMLT_STTS = 'New' THEN 'New' ELSE 'Executing' END AS SMLT_STTS, U.QUEUE_DT AS SMLT_REQ_DT, NVL(S.SMLT_BGNG_DT, U.EXCT_DT) AS SMLT_BGNG_DT, CASE WHEN U.SMLT_STTS = 'Failed' THEN NVL(U.END_DT, S.SMLT_END_DT) ELSE S.SMLT_END_DT END AS SMLT_END_DT, U.FRST_RGTR_ID, U.FRST_REG_DT, NVL(S.TMNL_ID, 'P01') AS TMNL_ID FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_USER_MSTR U LEFT JOIN ( SELECT SMLT_ID, MIN(SMLT_TYPE) AS SMLT_TYPE, MIN(EXCN_YMD) AS EXCN_YMD, MIN(TMNL_ID) AS TMNL_ID, MIN(PLAN_BGNG_DT) AS SMLT_BGNG_DT, MAX(PLAN_END_DT) AS SMLT_END_DT, MIN(FRST_RGTR_ID) KEEP (DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY FRST_REG_DT) AS FRST_RGTR_ID, MIN(FRST_REG_DT) AS FRST_REG_DT FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_STNG GROUP BY SMLT_ID ) S ON S.SMLT_ID = U.SMLT_ID UNION ALL SELECT S.SMLT_ID, S.SMLT_TYPE, S.EXCN_YMD, 'Finished' AS SMLT_STTS, CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP(6)) AS SMLT_REQ_DT, S.SMLT_BGNG_DT, S.SMLT_END_DT, S.FRST_RGTR_ID, S.FRST_REG_DT, S.TMNL_ID FROM ( SELECT SMLT_ID, MIN(SMLT_TYPE) AS SMLT_TYPE, MIN(EXCN_YMD) AS EXCN_YMD, MIN(TMNL_ID) AS TMNL_ID, MIN(PLAN_BGNG_DT) AS SMLT_BGNG_DT, MAX(PLAN_END_DT) AS SMLT_END_DT, MIN(FRST_RGTR_ID) KEEP (DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY FRST_REG_DT) AS FRST_RGTR_ID, MIN(FRST_REG_DT) AS FRST_REG_DT FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_STNG GROUP BY SMLT_ID ) S WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_USER_MSTR U WHERE U.SMLT_ID = S.SMLT_ID) AND S.SMLT_TYPE = 'Auto' ) A WHERE TO_CHAR(NVL(SMLT_REQ_DT, SMLT_BGNG_DT), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MI') BETWEEN #{bgnDt} AND #{endDt}
